system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The plugin auto-loads the right domain knowledge based on what files you're editing
system_prompt_style.note: Skills/hooks inject context per step; plugin layers on Claude Code.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Research agents analyze your codebase in parallel, then synthesize a structured implementation plan

context_compaction.evidence_quote: context-supervisor compresses all research into one summary
context_compaction.note: Compression strategies by size; host Claude Code compaction also referenced.

tool_count.note: Tools come from host Claude Code; plugin ships skills/agents, not tool schemas.

tool_schema_source.note: Skills/agents are hand-written markdown; Tidewave MCP tools optional.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote:
When your Phoenix app runs with
[Tidewave](https://github.com/tidewave-ai/tidewave_phoenix), the plugin detects
the local server and prefers its runtime tools.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The plugin implements a **Brainstorm, Plan, Work, Verify, Review, Compound** lifecycle.
loop_primitives.note: /phx:full is the fixed lifecycle; verify/review cycles back to fixes.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Plan checkboxes track progress.** `[x]` = done, `[ ]` = pending. `/phx:work` finds the first unchecked task and continues.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The plugin uses 26 agents organized into 3 tiers
multi_agent_topology.note: Orchestrators spawn specialists; nested subagent depth 3.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Spawns specialists IN PARALLEL based on feature needs

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Ask you how to proceed (start implementation, review plan, adjust)
human_in_loop.note: Also triage of review findings; host permission prompts configurable.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Filesystem is the state machine.** Each phase reads from the previous phase's output. No hidden state.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote:
Agents with `project` memory build up knowledge across sessions
in `.claude/agent-memory/<agent-name>/`.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Just run /phx:work on the same plan -- it finds the first [ ] and continues

self_verification.evidence_quote: verification-runner → mix compile, format, credo, test
self_verification.note: iron-law-judge and codex cross-model review are judges; hooks verify Iron Laws on edits.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Fix until Codex CLI review is clean (optional, needs codex)
retry_policy.note: /phx:full re-verifies after review fixes then cycles back; codex-loop optional.

rollback.evidence_quote:
Everything Elixir-specific self-gates on `mix.exs`, so the plugin is inert in
your non-Elixir repos.
rollback.note: No undo/revert/snapshot mechanism described in the hook or command lists.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
repeated `mix` failures escalate from hints to a
structured critic that consolidates the error history
termination_condition.note: Also hard-stop after planning phase; run ends when lifecycle completes.

cost_controls.note: Per-agent model tiers opus/sonnet/haiku; context compression reduces spend.

timeouts.evidence_quote: child runs have a five-minute timeout
timeouts.note: Stated for the Amp projection's child agent runs.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
This plugin runs skills, agents, and hooks inside Claude Code with your tool
permissions

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
runs skills, agents, and hooks inside Claude Code with your tool
permissions
filesystem_access.note: Reviewer agents are read-only by default.

network_policy.evidence_quote:
workflows can make visible, user-authorized
GitHub, Hex, web-search, or configured MCP calls through the host runtime

permission_model.evidence_quote:
`mix ecto.reset/drop`, `MIX_ENV=prod`, force
pushes are denied before they execute
permission_model.note: Blocklist hooks plus /phx:permissions Bash allowlist recommendations; host permission prompts also exist.

tracing.evidence_quote: Tier 1: Discover sessions and compute deterministic metrics
tracing.note: Session JSONL scanning tools are dev-only; progress.md/scratchpad logs are shipped.

replayability.evidence_quote: Just run /phx:work on the same plan -- it finds the first [ ] and continues

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The eval framework scores skills across **8 dimensions** and agents across **5 dimensions**.
eval_hooks.note: lab/eval/ scores skills/agents, not an external task benchmark.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
**Block destructive commands** — `mix ecto.reset/drop`, `MIX_ENV=prod`, force
pushes are denied before they execute
guardrails.note: route-intent/precompact hooks inject or rewrite prompt context.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Claude Code plugin for Elixir/Phoenix/LiveView — 26 specialist agents, Iron Laws enforcement, and Tidewave MCP integration.

model_agnostic.note: Canonical target is Claude Code; generated targets run on Codex, Amp, Pi, OpenCode, dsh.
